blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines—Rookie Joaquin Tovera shone anew in La Salle’s overtime win over rival Ateneo in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Saturday. Tovera drew praise from his teammate Mason Amos after leading the way with 21 points, seven rebounds and six assists, including a pass that led to Henry Agunanne’s two-handed dunk that sent the game into overtime with 12.1 seconds left in regulation. “He just has that composure.
